scientific_integrity: Combinatorial proof specifies suffix-barrier vertex encoding, full diametral-pair classification, a five-state continuation recurrence and two complete position sums. A standalone exact checker corroborates finite cases; no reliance on finite experiments for the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Applies to alternating upper type-C Gale intervals on 2r coordinates, r >= 2, with native Euclidean metric, and exactly the two outer vertex-distance shells. The finite checker covers r=1..6 by exhaustive enumeration and r=1..15 by independent pair-walk recursion. Unindexed prior work might cover equivalent formulas; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Two sharp Euclidean chord shells in alternating type-C Gale-interval polytopes
